name: pt.vclubroom.TestcontainersConfiguration
comment: Shared test infrastructure. The containers are Spring beans, so they live exactly as long as the (cached) application context: no more "Surefire is going to kill self fork JVM" 30 s hang caused by JUnit stopping static @Container fields while Spring still talks to Redis on shutdown.

name: pt.vclubroom.shared.error.GlobalExceptionHandlerTests
comment: The error contract every module relies on: RFC 9457 body, HTTP status per exception type, stable "code".
